curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with how alcohol and drugs impair driving, the marijuana blood limits, the crash statistics the handbook cites, and the two kinds of DUI penalties.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for administrative versus criminal penalties.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on impairment, marijuana limits and penalty types.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach implied consent and refusal, the illegal per se levels for adults, drivers under twenty-one and commercial drivers, arrests below the per se level, and administrative hearings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each testing rule; contrast cards for implied consent versus per se and for the three alcohol levels.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a test result or refusal and asking what follows.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the administrative revocations, the criminal penalties for first, second and later DUIs and for DUI causing death or serious injury, and reinstatement with an ignition interlock.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each penalty; contrast cards for first versus second offenses and the fine ranges.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz matching an offense to its penalties.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain DUI rules for drivers under eighteen and twenty-one, the open container law, sentencing factors and the chemical test fine, then the clues of an impaired driver and how to report one.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; a contrast card for the two lists of impairment clues.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on young-driver DUI rules, open containers and impaired-driver clues.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover how a lost license is reinstated and the many grounds for suspension or revocation: points, DUI, collisions, missed court dates, insurance, child support, graffiti, street racing and juvenile offenses.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each ground; a contrast card for uninsured-crash suspension versus failure to maintain insurance.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a situation and asking whether it can cost the license.
